reasons.B: Short declaratives and fragments with a quiet, understated stance and plain diction closest to the passage; only a couple of lines feel slightly crafted.
reasons.A: Plain, unhurried short sentences and no contractions match well, but a few longer 'and then' chains and the 'I do not mind the slowness' reflection sit a touch more explanatory than the author.
reasons.C: Right sentence length and a present-moment close, but quips ('I stand around', 'By hand. Not by machine.') pile on the clipped habit and read as imitation.
reasons.D: Long subordinated sentences, semicolons and a smooth essayistic flow are far from the author's clipped, fragmentary rhythm.
